draft.subject: Photographing Solaris Quartet's April 2 concert at Carnegie Hall.
draft.body: My name is Dan Wright and I'm a professional arts photographer here in NYC. I'm writing in regard to Solaris Quartet's April 2 performance at Carnegie Hall. I shoot quiet, no-flash documentary coverage, so the audience doesn't notice me and the playing isn't disturbed. I've been photographing at Carnegie Hall for close to ten years, and you can see my portfolio at danwrightphotography.com. If you don't have someone on it already, I'd be glad to talk about your photography plans for the performance. I look forward to hearing from you.
